description: This file contains the implementation of mathematical rounding functions in the PhpSpreadsheet project, including methods for rounding, ceiling, floor, nearest multiple, even, and odd number calculations.

classes.name: Round
classes.description: Provides static methods for various mathematical rounding functions such as round, up, down, multiple, even, and odd, used within the PhpSpreadsheet library for Excel formula emulation.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Performs standard rounding with validation, returning a number or array of numbers.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Rounds a number up to a specified number of decimal places, with compatibility for different PHP versions and handling for negative numbers.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Rounds a number down to a specified number of decimal places, with compatibility considerations.

methods.name: multiple
methods.description: Rounds a number to the nearest multiple of a specified value.

methods.name: even
methods.description: Rounds a number up to the nearest even integer.

methods.name: odd
methods.description: Rounds a number up to the nearest odd integer.
